headline: KLA (KLAC) Stock Looks Fully Valued After Its Huge Run
summary: KLA stock has delivered a very large 5 year gain, yet the latest valuation checks suggest the shares now lean expensive rather than clearly cheap. The share price has returned 462.1% over 5 years, which puts a lot of past success and optimism into the current valuation. Strong demand linked to AI infrastructure and advanced packaging can support expectations for future cash generation, while any slowdown in that spending cycle may quickly test what investors are currently willing to pay for...
